bio.text: Liz Krueger, a Democrat, represents New York State Senate District 28, which Ballotpedia lists her as holding since 2013 after representing District 26 from 2003 to 2013.

Ballotpedia lists a B.S. from Northwestern University (1979) and an M.A. in public policy from the University of Chicago (1981), and says her professional experience includes being the founding director of the New York City Food Bank.
A June 2018 University of Chicago alumni profile said she lost her first Senate race in 2000 by 193 votes after a recount, then won the special election that followed.

sources.title: Buoyed by Tidal Wave of Activism, Liz Krueger AM'81 Looks Toward the Future
